bioconda.name: bioconductor-biocviews
bioconda.summary: Categorized views of R package repositories

biotools.summary: Infrastructure to support 'views' used to classify Bioconductor packages. 'biocViews' are directed acyclic graphs of terms from a controlled vocabulary. There are three major classifications, corresponding to 'software', 'annotation', and 'experiment data' packages.
